Name: Nyapu Style NinoKito Portraits by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5]NinoKito- Custom NPC Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt
[/size][/b]

[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]
I adore Nyapu's portraits and wanted all of my mod to match that style. I am more of a husbando collector than a waifu one. When I saw NinoKito added as a custom NPC, I had to add him to my game. (Nino's Youtube videos are great.)  


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33670] Miihau's CatBoy NPC - The NinoKito Mod[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. You should get a prompt to replace
the original files if you do it right. If you need more guidance, Nyapu
has a great example on their page. 
[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art.
GIANT thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url], you are a lifesaver, and I wouldn't be able to code without you!
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/151409123]Miihau[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.
Thank you, NinoKito, for allowing Miihau to add you as an NPC!
[b]
[/b][i]If your curious what I am working on next please check out my social media page or my nexus profile. [/i][/i]
